title: The Heart of Atlantis: The Five Crystals

act1.title: The Heart of Atlantis
act1.text:
Atlantis was a living kingdom beneath the ocean, powered by the Heart of Atlantis.
The Heart did not fail because of war. It failed because people stopped guarding the Five Crystals form the founding era.
At first, the change was subtle.

- People became dependent on machines and forgot how to repair them.
- Citizens stopped visiting neighbours and withdrew behind privacy barriers.
- Families avoided difficult conversations and pretended everything was fine.
- Scholars cared more about winning arguments than finding truth.
- People asked the Heart for prosperity and protection, but rarely for love or purpose.

No one noticed—or no one cared. But the Heart noticed.
Atlantis was dying… and almost no one could see it happening.

female_act.title: Alethea, Guardian of Archives
female_act.description:
Alethea was a guardian of the Ancient Archives.
She spent her life studying the discipline of heart, mind, and character.
She was Patient, observant, stubbornly compassionate and was neither famous nor powerful.
She discovered the first fissure beneath the Heart Chamber.
Tried to inform the council, but no one believe her.

male_act.title: Elion, the Warrior
male_act.description:
Elion was Atlantis’s most celebrated warrior.
He had won every major tournament.
His name was painted on training halls and carved into medals.
But victory had made him lonely.
He trained until his muscles trembled and refused help, even when he was wounded.
Then, during a fierce battle, something impossible happened.
The face of his enemy suddenly changed—and Elion was staring at his own face.
In that instant, he understood:
*To be a leader is not to defeat others, but to protect them.*

act2.title: The Beginning
act2.text:
When Alethea discovered the first fissure,
Elion woke from another nightmare with a strange blue mark burning across his palm.
Neither understood the connection.
But the Heart had chosen them because they represented two things Atlantis had forgotten:
- Knowledge with compassion,
- Strength with purpose.

chapters.title: The Celebration
chapters.text:
The Day of Founding began with music. Citizens filled the plaza. Children released glowing lanterns. The Heart of Atlantis shone brighter than ever before.
Alethea watched the blue light spread. For one moment, she believed the crisis was over.
Then the Heart pulsed. The music stopped. The lights vanished. The eastern dome began to buckle.
Alethea ran for the emergency controls. Elion reached them first.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Move!

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: I know the system better than you.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: I can hold the panel when it...

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: The panel fell. Elion caught it. A blue mark glowed on his palm.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: What is that?

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Nothing.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: That is not nothing.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Then ask me after we keep half the city from drowning.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: They reached the valves together.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Close the east gate!

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: The south will lose air if we do. Leave it open!

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Then the east floods.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: We need the Council. Lives are at stake — that's their responsibility.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: There's no time for that. Seal the eastern dome.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: And the people in the west? We'd be choosing who lives.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Then force the system open!

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: It could break completely. Better to organize a full evacuation and save everyone.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Too risky. We could lose everyone — including ourselves.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: The dome shuddered. There was no more time to argue.

choices.title: Organize a full evacuation
choices.narrative: Alethea sent the emergency teams to save the eastern district. Elion organised carrying lines.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: Alethea sent the emergency teams to save the eastern district. Elion organised carrying lines.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: Walk to the western shelters. Do not run. Hold hands.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Builders, follow me. Medics, stay with the injured.

dialog.speaker: Men
dialog.text: Why should we listen to you?

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Because the ocean won't wait for us to argue.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: The evacuation succeeded. But beneath the plaza, the old tunnels collapsed. The shock cracked the Physical Crystal down its center.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: We saved the district.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Then why does it feel like we lost?

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: Because doing right doesn't control every consequence.

choices.title: Seal the Eastern Dome
choices.narrative: Elion sealed the eastern gate to protect the central city. Alethea warned the southern districts would lose oxygen.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: Elion sealed the eastern gate to protect the central city. Alethea warned the southern districts would lose oxygen.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Close it. We protect the majority.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: That's not the same as protecting everyone.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: The gate sealed. The center stabilized, but the south went dark. Families were trapped before rescue boats arrived. The First Crystal gave only a faint glow.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: I chose the safer path.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: Yes. But safety without cooperation still leaves people behind.

choices.title: Wait for the Council
choices.narrative: Elion pushed to act. Alethea insisted they wait for the Council's approval.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: Elion pushed to act. Alethea insisted they wait for the Council's approval.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: There's no time for this.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: We need authorization.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: By the time the Council answered, the eastern dome had already flooded. The delay cost them the district. The First Crystal stayed dark.

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: Waiting was the real danger.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: I know that now.

choices.title: Force the system
choices.narrative: Elion forced the machinery open. Alethea tried to override the system. Their disagreement turned physical.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: Elion forced the machinery open. Alethea tried to override the system. Their disagreement turned physical.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: Release the lever!

dialog.speaker: Elion
dialog.text: You're too slow!

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: You'll tear it apart!

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: The mechanism broke. A burst of pressure threw them across the plaza. The dome held, but bridges collapsed and supplies were destroyed. The First Crystal turned black.

dialog.speaker: Alethea
dialog.text: Strength without discipline isn't protection.

dialog.speaker: Narrator
dialog.text: Elion had no answer.
